name: tippecanoe
role: CLI that builds vector tilesets (.pmtiles, .mbtiles) from GeoJSON
notes: 2026-11-27: Lead from prospects/inbox/2026-11-26-discovery.md; stable 2.79.0 and BSD-2-Clause match brew info. This is the Felt fork; mapbox/tippecanoe stopped at 1.36.0.
2026-11-27: The lead's reproducibility caveat held: archive bytes repeat only for an identical command, because the output file name and input paths are written into the archive metadata.

evidence.result: 500 points + route + region, -Z0 -z8 --drop-densest-as-needed: 11376-byte .pmtiles, 3 layers, unique points per zoom 1,1,2,5,13,32,80,201,500; tile-join -l points keeps 500; -zg chose maxzoom 6; same command twice byte-identical (8 of 8 runs), 9 of 9 checks pass
evidence.scope: macOS arm64: GeoJSON to PMTiles, per-zoom counts via tippecanoe-decode and tile-join. Bytes repeat only for an identical command (name and paths are in metadata). No renderer, no real data.

summary: Turns your own GeoJSON into a zoom-thinned .pmtiles tileset, the missing step before an offline, pinned map scene.
use_when: Turn a production's own GeoJSON (routes, regions, points) into a local vector tileset
avoid_when: Need an OpenStreetMap basemap: build it with a planet-scale tool, not tippecanoe
Need to render tiles to an image: chiitiler or maplibre-native

assessment.rationale: Felt's maintained fork writes .pmtiles directly from GeoJSON, FlatGeobuf or CSV, with zoom-dependent thinning and simplification. BSD-2-Clause, Homebrew bottle, no network. Fills the gap between a map renderer and its tiles. Output depends on pinned flags.
